title: thelypteris cruciata
intro: Thelypteris cruciata, commonly known as Cross-leaved Fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a type of vascular plant that is native to tropical and subtropical regions of the world. The health benefits of Thelypteris cruciata include its potential use in treating inflammation, wounds, and infections due to its antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, suggesting its potential use in traditional medicine.
